name: Matsushita Ukyou
source:
A mama's boy that loves breast. 

In Chichi Miko!!:
He has been asked by his grandmother to select and train the new Breast Priestess.

In Chichi Miko!! Plus 1:
He married Touka and lives with her. They have a daughter.
